request.description:
Publicly accessible endpoint for user registration. Requires a phone number and password, with an optional email address. Limited to 6 requests per minute using throttle middleware.

Request Body:  
phone_number (string, required)  
password (string, required)  
email (string, optional)

Responses:  
201 — User registered successfully.  
422 — Validation failed.  
429 — Too many requests.

Authenticated endpoint for logging out the current user by invalidating their authentication token.

Responses:  
204 — Successfully logged out.  
401 — Unauthorized. The provided authentication token is invalid or missing.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving the list of available cities.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the collection of cities.

Admin-only endpoint for creating a new city.

Responses:  
201 — City created successfully. Returns the created city resource.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
422 — The provided city name is not acceptable.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving the details of a specific city.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the city details.

Admin-only endpoint for deleting a city identified by its ID in the path.

Responses:  
204 — City deleted successfully.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
404 — City not found.

Admin-only endpoint for creating a new specialty.

Request Body:  
title (string, required)  
description (string, optional)

Responses:  
201 — Specialty created successfully. Returns the created specialty resource.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
422 — Validation failed.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving the collection of available specialties.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the collection of specialties.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving the details of a specific specialty.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the specialty details.  
404 — Specialty not found.

Admin-only endpoint for deleting a specialty identified by its ID in the path.

Responses:  
204 — Specialty deleted successfully.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
404 — Specialty not found.

Admin-only endpoint for updating an existing specialty.

Request Body:  
title (string, optional)  
description (string, optional)

Responses:  
200 — Specialty updated successfully. Returns the updated specialty resource.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
404 — Specialty not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for creating a doctor profile. Accessible to admins and doctors. Admins must provide a `user_id` to associate the profile with an existing user. Doctors cannot provide this field.

Request Body:  
first_name (string, required, max 255)  
last_name (string, required, max 255)  
gender (boolean, required)  
education (string, required)  
specialty_ids (array of integers, required, must reference existing specialties without duplicates)  
city_id (integer, required, must reference an existing city)  
user_id (integer, required for admins, prohibited for doctors; must reference an existing user)

Responses:  
201 — Doctor profile created successfully. Returns the created doctor resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to create a doctor profile.  
409 — The user already has a doctor profile.  
422 — Validation failed or the specified user does not have the doctor role.

Authenticated endpoint for updating an existing doctor profile. Accessible to admins and the doctor who owns the profile. All request fields are optional.

Request Body:  
first_name (string, optional, max 255)  
last_name (string, optional, max 255)  
gender (boolean, optional)  
education (string, optional)  
specialty_ids (array of integers, optional; must reference existing specialties without duplicates)  
city_id (integer, optional; must reference an existing city)

Responses:  
200 — Doctor profile updated successfully. Returns the updated doctor resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this profile.  
404 — Doctor profile not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving a collection of doctor profiles.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the collection of doctor profiles.

Publicly accessible endpoint for retrieving the profile of a specific doctor.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the doctor profile.  
404 — Doctor not found.

Authenticated endpoint for updating a doctor's specialties. Accessible to admins and the doctor who owns the profile.

Request Body:  
specialty_ids (array of integers, required; doctor specialty IDs)

Responses:  
200 — Doctor specialties updated successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update these specialties.  
404 — Doctor profile not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Admin-only endpoint for verifying a doctor profile identified by its ID in the path.

Responses:  
204 — Doctor profile verified successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have admin privileges.  
404 — Doctor profile not found.

Authenticated endpoint for retrieving a patient profile identified by its ID in the path. Accessible to admins, the patient who owns the profile, and doctors who have had an appointment with the patient.

Responses:  
200 — Patient profile retrieved successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to access this profile.  
404 — Patient profile not found.

Authenticated endpoint for updating a patient profile. All request fields are optional.

Request Body:  
first_name (string, optional, max 255)  
last_name (string, optional, max 255)  
gender (boolean, optional)  
birth_date (date, optional, format: Y-m-d, cannot be in the future)  
blood_type (string, optional, one of: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-)  
city_id (integer, optional, must reference an existing city)

Responses:  
200 — Patient profile updated successfully. Returns the updated patient resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this profile.  
404 — Patient profile not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for creating a patient profile. Admins must provide a `user_id` to associate the profile with an existing user. Other users cannot provide this field.

Request Body:  
first_name (string, required, max 255)  
last_name (string, required, max 255)  
gender (boolean, required)  
birth_date (date, required, format: Y-m-d, cannot be in the future)  
blood_type (string, required, one of: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-)  
city_id (integer, required, must reference an existing city)  
user_id (integer, required for admins, prohibited for other users)

Responses:  
201 — Patient profile created successfully. Returns the created patient resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for retrieving a patient's medical history. Accessible to admins, the patient who owns the profile, and doctors who have had an appointment with the patient.

Responses:  
200 — Successfully retrieved the collection of medical history records.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to access this medical history.  
404 — Patient not found.

Authenticated endpoint for creating a medical history record for a patient.

Request Body:  
title (string, required, max 255)  
description (string, required)  
type (string, required; one of: condition, surgery, medication)

Responses:  
201 — Medical history record created successfully. Returns the created resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to create this record.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for updating an existing medical history record.

Request Body:  
title (string, optional, max 255)  
description (string, optional)  
type (string, optional; one of: condition, surgery, medication)

Responses:  
200 — Medical history record updated successfully. Returns the updated resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this record.  
404 — Medical history record not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for deleting an existing medical history record.

Responses:  
204 — Medical history record deleted successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to delete this record.  
404 — Medical history record not found.

Authenticated endpoint for creating a doctor availability. Accessible to authorized doctors.

Request Body:  
type (string, required; one of: recurring, once)  
days_of_week (array, required for recurring availability; prohibited for once availability)  
days_of_week.\* (string; one of: MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA, SU; values must be distinct)  
dates (array, required for once availability; prohibited for recurring availability)  
dates.\* (date, format Y-m-d; must be today or later)  
shift_start_at (time, required; format H)  
shift_end_at (time, required; format H; must be after shift_start_at)

Responses:  
201 — Availability created successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to create this availability.  
409 — Conflict. Availability conflicts with an existing availability.

Authenticated endpoint for deleting an existing doctor availability.

Responses:  
204 — Availability deleted successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to delete this availability.  
404 — Availability not found.

Publicly accessible endpoint for listing available appointment slots for a doctor.

Responses:  
200 — Available slots retrieved successfully. Returns a collection of available appointment slots.

Authenticated endpoint for updating an existing doctor availability.

Request Body:  
shift_start_at (time, optional; format H)  
shift_end_at (time, optional; format H)  
new_date (date, optional; format Y-m-d; only applicable to once availabilities)  
new_days (array, optional; at least one day; only applicable to recurring availabilities)  
new_days.\* (string; one of: MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA, SU)

Responses:  
200 — Availability updated successfully. Returns the updated resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this availability.  
404 — Availability not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for listing doctor availabilities.

Responses:  
200 — Availabilities retrieved successfully. Returns a collection of availability resources.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to view these availabilities.

Authenticated endpoint for creating a doctor unavailability period.

Request Body:  
start_at (datetime, required; must be today or later and before or equal to end_at)  
end_at (datetime, required; must be today or later and after or equal to start_at)  
reason (string, optional)

Responses:  
201 — Unavailability created successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to create this unavailability.  
409 — Conflict unavailability period.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for updating an existing doctor unavailability period.

Request Body:  
start_at (datetime, optional; must be today or later and before or equal to end_at)  
end_at (datetime, optional; must be today or later and after or equal to start_at)  
reason (string, optional)

Responses:  
200 — Unavailability updated successfully. Returns the updated resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this unavailability.  
404 — Unavailability not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for retrieving a doctor unavailability period.

Responses:  
200 — Unavailability retrieved successfully. Returns the unavailability resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to view this unavailability.  
404 — Unavailability not found.

Authenticated endpoint for deleting an existing doctor unavailability period.

Responses:  
204 — Unavailability deleted successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to delete this unavailability.  
404 — Unavailability not found.

Authenticated endpoint for booking an appointment. Patients must specify the doctor they wish to book with.

Request Body:  
datetime (datetime, required; must be today or later)  
patient_notes (string, optional)  
doctor_id (integer, required for patients; must reference an existing doctor profile)

Responses:  
201 — Appointment created successfully. Returns the created appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to create this appointment.  
409 — Conflict. The requested appointment slot is no longer available.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for listing appointments. Patients can view their own appointments, doctors can view their own appointments, and admins can view all appointments.

Responses:  
200 — Appointments retrieved successfully. Returns a collection of appointment resources.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to view these appointments.

Authenticated endpoint for retrieving an appointment. Accessible to the patient or doctor associated with the appointment, and to admins.

Responses:  
200 — Appointment retrieved successfully. Returns the appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to view this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.

Authenticated endpoint for updating an existing appointment's patient notes.

Request Body:  
patient_notes (string, optional; may be null)

Responses:  
200 — Appointment updated successfully. Returns the updated appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to update this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for rescheduling an existing appointment.

Request Body:  
datetime (datetime, required; must be today or later)

Responses:  
200 — Appointment rescheduled successfully. Returns the updated appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to reschedule this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.  
409 — Conflict. The requested appointment slot is unavailable.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for cancelling an existing appointment.

Request Body:  
cancellation_reason (string, optional; may be null)

Responses:  
200 — Appointment cancelled successfully. Returns the updated appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. User does not have permission to cancel this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.  
422 — Validation failed.

Authenticated endpoint for approving an appointment. Accessible only to the doctor associated with the appointment.

Responses:  
200 — Appointment approved successfully. Returns the updated appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. Only the assigned doctor can approve this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.  
409 — Appointment cannot be approved in its current state.

Authenticated endpoint for marking an appointment as completed. Accessible only to the doctor associated with the appointment.

Responses:  
200 — Appointment marked as completed successfully. Returns the updated appointment resource.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. Only the assigned doctor can complete this appointment.  
404 — Appointment not found.  
409 — Appointment cannot be completed in its current state.

Authenticated endpoint for deleting an appointment. Accessible only to admins.

Responses:  
204 — Appointment deleted successfully.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. Only admins can delete appointments.  
404 — Appointment not found.

Authenticated endpoint for retrieving system-wide analytics and statistics. Accessible only to admins.

Responses:  
200 — Analytics retrieved successfully. Returns the requested analytics data.  
401 — Unauthenticated.  
403 — Forbidden. Only admins can access analytics.
